CRM Management Shouldn't Be Complicated

Companies that are growing shouldn't need to worry about losing sales due to the fact that customers' information is scattered throughout spreadsheets and emails, as well as messages, phone calls, and a variety of sales tools. Vellko ERP consolidates your lead and customer data, automates routine sales tasks, and gives sales representatives live insight into each lead and opportunity, follow-up, and interaction with customers.

How Vellko CRM Works

Step 1: Schedule a Free CRM Demo

Learn the ways Vellko CRM can be a good fit for your lead management and sales needs.

Step 2: Understand Your Sales Process

Our team reviews your current lead sources, sales pipeline, customer monitoring, follow-up processes, and reporting needs.

Step 3: Configure Workflows & Import CRM Data

Create lead assignment rules, customer fields, workflows, and reports while safely importing your CRM information.

Step 4: Train Your Sales Team & Go Live

Your sales team should be trained on the platform and start using your CRM, with ongoing support.

Dedicated CRM Implementation Support

The process of implementing a CRM isn't just about installing software. It's about helping your sales staff improve their methods to manage the leads as well as customers.

Our CRM experts help with data migration and workflow setting, sales pipeline configuration and user training, as well as customization and ongoing support to make sure that the transition is smooth.
